profile.reading: Verizon Communications is a large American telecommunications company. The rows addressed in this pass are generic Verizon or Verizon Wireless named buildings in this registry, most likely network switching or data facilities rather than customer facing wholesale colocation sites, and this operator does not publish a customer facing locations directory for them the way colocation providers do. This specific row, Verizon, in Clark County, Nevada, could not be confidently matched to a specific address this session. A cloudandcolocation.com listing for a Verizon Business Advanced Data Center in Las Vegas gives 3111 South Valley View Boulevard, Las Vegas, NV 89102, but this session found no second source corroborating that address, and a separate Las Vegas Review-Journal article describing what it called a secret Verizon data center placed that facility in North Las Vegas without giving a street address, a location this session could not reconcile with the Valley View Boulevard listing or confirm as the same facility as this row. Given the single uncorroborated aggregator address and a local press account describing a seemingly different location, this session declined to assign an address rather than guess which, if either, matches this rows own coordinates.
